adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, parseRefreshTokenResponse (lines 12-32 of parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts) returns the result of schema.safeParse(response), which is an object like {success: true, data: {...}}. In CalendarService.ts line 97, this return value is assigned directly to 'key' and then persisted via prisma.credential.update with 'data: { key }'. This means the credential stored in the database will have the safeParse envelope structure instead of the actual token fields. The next time the service tries to parse this credential with googleCredentialSchema.parse(), it will fail because the structure is wrong ({success, data} instead of {access_token, refresh_token, etc.}). This is a real bug that would break Google Calendar integration after the first token refresh.
